ns2:section.sectionText: MCB 244 should be taken concurrently with this course. Labs begin on August 24, 2021. Lab will not meet on September 7, 2021. Registration for this class is restricted to students in majors and programs for which it is required and will be allowed by authorization only. Should you wish to take the class, not fall into that category and wish to be considered for authorization, please add your name to the online waitlist at http://go.illinois.edu/mcb245_FA21_waitlist.
